title: Normalized finite scalar comparison of total tensors
statement: Let C be any small site, A a commutative ring and I an ideal. Write B for the inverse limit of the constant quotient sheaves B_n=A/I^(n+1) and pi_n:B -> B_n for its projections [def-sfb-constant-completion-coefficient-data]. For every n, the direct-sum total tensor of two B-complexes followed by actual scalar extension along pi_n and restriction to B is naturally isomorphic to the total tensor over B_n of their separately extended complexes, restricted to B [def-coef-ringed-tensor-hom-model]. In every bidegree p+q=k and over every site object, this isomorphism sends (a*b) tensor (x tensor y) to (a tensor x) tensor (b tensor y), for all sections a,b of B_n and x,y of the input degree-p and degree-q modules. There are no Noetherian, flatness, boundedness, nonzero or nonempty assumptions. The Lean interface records the additive structure of the reduction functor as a proof-valued instance argument; this is supplied by the additivity of the actual scalar-extension and restriction functors, and places no further mathematical restriction on the site or coefficients.

proof.text: Apply the already proved scalarTensorTotal helper of lem-pur-integral-tensor-reduction-tower-comparison to the actual change functor for pi_n. Whisker the resulting natural isomorphism by restriction of scalars. Its normalization on the scalar extension unit gives the formula with a=b=1.

proof.text: A sheafified tensor generator is bilinear: the generator of a*x and b*y is (a*b) times the generator of x and y. The scalar extension section with coefficient a is a times its unit section. Apply linearity of the comparison and the unit normalization to obtain the claimed formula for arbitrary a and b.

theorem normalizedFiniteTensorComparison (n : ℕ)
    [(reduction J A I true n).Additive] :
    ∃ e : coefficientTotalTensor.{u, u, u} J (completed J A I) ⋙
        (reduction J A I true n).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ) ≅
      ((change (projection J A I n)).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).prod
          ((change (projection J A I n)).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)) ⋙
        coefficientTotalTensor.{u, u, u} J (finite J A I n) ⋙
          (res (projection J A I n)).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ),
      ∀ (P Q : Cx (completed J A I)) (p q k : ℤ) (h : p + q = k) (U : Cᵒᵖ)
        (a b : (finite J A I n).obj.obj U)
        (x : (P.X p).val.obj U) (y : (Q.X q).val.obj U),
        ((e.hom.app (P, Q)).f k).val.app U
          (tensorSection (projection J A I n)
            (((coefficientTotalTensor.{u, u, u} J (completed J A I)).obj (P, Q)).X k)
            U (a * b) (coefficientTensorGenerator.{u, u, u} J (completed J A I)
              P Q p q k h U x y)) =
          coefficientTensorGenerator.{u, u, u} J (finite J A I n)
            (((change (projection J A I n)).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P)
            (((change (projection J A I n)).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj Q)
            p q k h U (tensorSection (projection J A I n) (P.X p) U a x)
              (tensorSection (projection J A I n) (Q.X q) U b y)
